edm_val.selection: max whole-VAL pooled PSNR, then slice SSIM

perceptual_protocol.lpips: lpips 0.1.4, alex backbone, calibrated v0.1; grayscale repeated RGB, float32 [-1,1], native XY resolution; equal slice mean
perceptual_protocol.fid: torch-fidelity 0.3.0 TensorFlow-compatible InceptionV3 pool3 2048; grayscale repeated RGB; round(255*x) uint8; extractor TensorFlow-compatible bilinear resize to 299x299
perceptual_protocol.fid_aggregation: one cohort FID from float64 global feature sums and outer products, unbiased sample covariance (N-1); never mean case/rank FID
perceptual_protocol.scope: all retained slices, full field of view, no foreground cropping or per-image intensity normalization
perceptual_protocol.interpretation: 2D ImageNet metrics on correlated MRI slices; FID is cohort-size dependent and is not a 3D anatomical or clinical metric
perceptual_protocol.selection: reporting only; LPIPS/FID never select TEST cases or checkpoints
